text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the time off earlier. Thanks 
to that, I was able to catch up on all the 
shows I had recorded.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Have you heard of "Justice Never Sleeps"? 
It's a TV drama depicting the duties of 
police officers.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Working tirelessly and pushing oneself to 
the bone for peace... That's truly the 
mark of an ally of justice...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Utterly dazzling! She is my role model, 
yes sir!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno seemed able to recharge her 
energy on her day off!
